Maya — thanks, great questions. High level options and constraints below; I also attached a working private-offer worksheet for modeling.

TL;DR
- Two practical approaches: 1) list-price uplift (Marketplace private offer lists higher price; reseller gets commission off the uplift separately) or 2) post-sale rebate (vendor issues rebate to reseller outside Marketplace). Both are used; choice depends on the reseller accounting requirements.

Details:
- List-price uplift: we set a slightly higher SKU price in the private offer. EdgeCloud invoices the customer at their agreed rate and keeps the commission. Pros: simple for Marketplace mechanics. Cons: reseller needs clear inter-company invoicing; not ideal if reseller expects Redwood to pay commission directly.
- Rebate flow: Redwood invoices at list price, then issues commission payments to EdgeCloud under a partner agreement. Pros: more control & audit trail. Cons: adds an extra payout process and requires contract language.

Marketplace constraints:
- You can include multiple SKU tiers in one private offer but AWS expects clear SKU mapping and a single private-offer identifier per transaction. If you need separate billing/fulfillment flows for committed vs on-demand, we typically create two linked SKUs.

My ask from you: confirm the reseller preferred model (pass-through vs rebate) and an initial ARR / expected monthly consumption so I can populate the attached.

Hi Karthik / Marissa / Maya —

Thanks for the details. Confirming the Marketplace stance:

- AWS supports private offers where the listed SKU price is set by the seller; any commercial arrangements between buyer and reseller (including pass-through commissions) are managed off-platform as long as the private offer transaction maps to the seller SKU.
- For reseller pass-through where EdgeCloud invoices the buyer directly, we recommend registering EdgeCloud as an Authorized Reseller under the seller account and documenting the flow in the reseller agreement.
- If you want AWS to show reseller-specific fields on the invoice, that requires configuring reseller relationships in the Marketplace Seller Central and may need an update to your payout settings.

Link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/private-offers/ (see section: Resellers & Pass-through)

Attached is our short guide for private-offer mechanics. Happy to set a 30-minute sync with Marketplace GTM — propose Thursday 3/12 if that works.

Regards,
